units.name: sshd-packer-config.service
units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=Write sshd config for packer provisioning
Before=sshd.service
After=local-fs.target
DefaultDependencies=no

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/bin/bash -c 'mkdir -p /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d && printf "ClientAliveInterval 0\nClientAliveCountMax 0\n" > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/90-packer-provisioning.conf'

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

units.name: unbind-sriov-vf.service
units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=Unbind SR-IOV VF to prevent data path switching during provisioning
Before=sshd.service
After=network.target
DefaultDependencies=no

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/bin/bash -c 'for dev in /sys/bus/pci/drivers/mlx5_core/????:??:??.?; do [ -e "$dev" ] && echo "$(basename $dev)" > /sys/bus/pci/drivers/mlx5_core/unbind || true; done'

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
